label.name: Name
label.noBenefits: No benefits. Enrolment, providers and claims are Phase 12's; an employer contribution is representable only as a component.
label.noConversion: No currency conversion. Every total is per currency, and nothing is ever summed across them.
label.noDeductions: No deductions. Statutory deductions are Payroll's and loan recovery is Phase 10.1's.
label.noPayroll: No payroll. Compensation states entitlement; what is actually paid for a period is Payroll's.
label.noStatutory: No statutory content. No minimum wage, no mandated allowance, no tax treatment — all of it is configuration a tenant or a country pack supplies.
label.unavailable: Not signed in, or the service is unavailable.

rejection.adjustment_currencies_differ: The amounts on an adjustment must be in one currency.
rejection.amount_malformed: An amount must be whole minor units.
rejection.amount_outside_grade_range: That amount is outside the pay grade's range on that date.
rejection.amount_outside_plan_bounds: That amount is outside the bounds the plan sets for this component.
rejection.basis_points_out_of_range: A percentage must be whole basis points within range.
rejection.change_after_employment_end: A compensation change cannot take effect after the employment ended.
rejection.change_before_employment_start: A compensation change cannot take effect before the employment started.
rejection.code_malformed: A code may contain lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
rejection.compensation_already_recorded: That compensation has already been recorded from this source.
rejection.compensation_source_unknown: That source is not one this product recognises.
rejection.component_already_assigned: This component is already assigned over that period.
rejection.component_basis_is_circular: A percentage component cannot take its basis from itself.
rejection.component_expired: That component has been superseded and cannot be assigned.
rejection.component_kind_unknown: That component kind is not one this product recognises.
rejection.component_not_permitted_by_plan: The governing plan does not permit that component.
rejection.component_not_published: A component must be published before it can be assigned.
rejection.component_recurrence_disagrees_with_kind: A component's kind and recurrence must agree.
rejection.concurrent_modification: Somebody else changed this first. Read it again and retry.
rejection.count_out_of_range: That count is outside the permitted range.
rejection.country_pack_version_required: A country pack must name its version.
rejection.currency_code_malformed: A currency must be a three-letter ISO 4217 code.
rejection.currency_exponent_implausible: That number of decimal places is not plausible for a currency.
rejection.decision_sequence_out_of_range: A decision's sequence must be a positive whole number.
rejection.decision_unknown: A decision is either an approval or a rejection.
rejection.employment_not_found: No such employment on that date.
rejection.fixed_amount_takes_no_basis: A fixed amount does not take a percentage basis.
rejection.import_batch_too_large: An import batch is bounded. Submit fewer rows.
rejection.import_counts_exceed_submitted: A batch cannot report more rows than it received.
rejection.import_source_unknown: That import source is not one this product recognises.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: A metadata entry is too long.
rejection.no_plan_assigned: No compensation plan governs this employment on that date.
rejection.pay_grade_not_effective: That pay grade is not in effect on that date.
rejection.percentage_basis_currency_mismatch: A percentage cannot be taken of an amount in another currency.
rejection.percentage_basis_not_assigned: The component this percentage is taken of is not assigned on that date.
rejection.percentage_requires_a_basis: A percentage must name what it is a percentage of, and how much.
rejection.period_ends_before_it_starts: A period cannot end before it starts.
rejection.plan_assignment_ambiguous: Two plans claim the same scope on that date. Resolve the configuration.
rejection.plan_code_taken: That plan code and version already exist.
rejection.plan_not_draft: A published plan version cannot be changed.
rejection.plan_not_published: A plan must be published before it can be assigned.
rejection.plan_requires_an_approver: A plan that requires approval must name how many approvals.
rejection.range_currencies_differ: A range's bounds must be in one currency.
rejection.range_out_of_order: A range's minimum, midpoint and maximum must be in order.
rejection.recurrence_unknown: That recurrence is not one this product recognises.
rejection.reversal_after_effective_date: A decision can only be reversed while the change is still future-dated. Record a new effective-dated change instead.
rejection.rounding_mode_unknown: A rounding mode must be stated, and must be one this product supports.
rejection.scale_currency_differs: A pay scale must be in its grade's currency.
rejection.scope_id_disagrees_with_scope: A tenant assignment names nobody; every other scope must name somebody.
rejection.scope_unknown: That scope is not one this product recognises.
rejection.self_approval_refused: Somebody other than the requester must decide.
rejection.step_number_out_of_range: A step number must be a positive whole number.
rejection.step_requires_exactly_one_parent: A step belongs to a pay scale or to a pay grade — exactly one.
rejection.subject_kind_unknown: That subject is not one this product recognises.
rejection.text_requires_both_languages: Both English and Arabic are required.
rejection.change_kind_unknown: That change kind is not one this product recognises.
